stem: Itaipu Dam built on the river Parana is one of the largest dams in the world. Which of the following two countries have it as a joint project?
expl: Itaipu Dam is a joint venture between Brazil and Paraguay (both South American countries) at the border of Brazil and Paraguay border on the Parana river. The dam is 196 meters high and 7919 meters long.

stem: World’s longest sea bridge has been built on -
expl: The One of the world's longest cross-sea bridges is built over Jiaozhou Bay. The bridge spans 41.58 km and connects the eastern coastal city of Qingdao to the suburb of Huangdao. It was opened to traffic on 30 June, 2011.

stem: The Aswan High Dam is located –
expl: The Aswan High Dam is located in Egypt on the African continent. It is built on the River Nile. Its water is used for irrigation of crops, and to generate hydroelectric power. Its construction started in 1960.

stem: The place where China has started construction of a dam on Brahmaputra River in Nov. 2010, is
expl: The Zangmu Dam is a gravity dam on the Yarlung Zangbo/ Brahmaputra River in Tibet. The dam is expected to reduce the flow of the Brahmaputra River.
